name: live-presence
description: Privacy-first, consent-based live presence and screen-sharing application

scripts.check: npm run check:config && npm --workspace server run check && npm --workspace apps/desktop run check && npm --workspace apps/viewer run check
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:server
scripts.test:shared: tsx --test shared/src/client.test.ts shared/src/webrtc.test.ts apps/viewer/src/remote-camera.test.ts apps/viewer/src/device-preference.test.ts apps/viewer/src/viewer-startup.test.ts apps/viewer/src/viewer-status.test.ts apps/viewer/src/viewer-media.test.ts
